piece: Put together the puzzle in the Puzzle world
friend: Chose to help others three times

PHRASES: I don't need to be like someone else. I can develop what is mine.
The Almighty gave everyone their own piece of the great puzzle.
My task is not to be the best at everything, but to unfold the gift I was given.

wealth.year: A year has passed. You have a palace, gardens with ponds and a treasury full to the ceiling. You can gather even more treasure. Go on!
wealth.evening: Evening. You are standing in the middle of a huge palace. The servants have gone to bed. What do you feel?

fame.year: A year has passed. People recognise you in the street, you have millions of followers. And you can collect even more likes. Go on!
fame.evening: Evening. Your phone won't stop buzzing with notifications. You are sitting in your room alone. What do you feel?

mind.year: A year has passed. You can solve any problem, scientists ask you for advice. But you can learn even more. Go on!
mind.evening: Evening. You have read every book in the city. You know almost everything. What do you feel?

power.year: A year has passed. The whole city obeys you. You can give even more orders. Go on!
power.evening: Evening. Everyone carries out your orders, but nobody talks to you just like that. What do you feel?

adventure.year: A year has passed. You have discovered new islands, mountains and caves. There can be even more discoveries. Go on!
adventure.evening: Evening. You are in yet another new port. Nobody knows you here. What do you feel?

beauty.year: A year has passed. Every day is a celebration for you, the finest things, journeys. You can throw even more celebrations. Go on!
beauty.evening: Evening. The party is over, the guests have gone home. Tomorrow will be just the same. What do you feel?

QUALITIES: I know how to be a friend
I notice what others don't see
I can wait and not rush
I make things with my hands
QUALITIES_Y: I know how to be a friend

need.title: What do others need?
opts: someone to stand up for them
someone to support them on a hard day

SPECIES.name: Etrog
SPECIES.y: The etrog has both taste and fragrance. It is like a person who both learns Torah and does good deeds.
SPECIES.t: It has both taste and fragrance. The Midrash says: this is a person who has both Torah and good deeds.

SPECIES.name: Lulav
SPECIES.y: Dates from the palm tree are tasty, but have no fragrance. This is a person who learns a lot of Torah.
SPECIES.t: The fruit of the date palm is tasty but has no fragrance. This is a person who has Torah, but fewer good deeds.

SPECIES.name: Myrtle
SPECIES.y: Myrtle smells good, but nobody eats it. This is a person who does many good deeds.
SPECIES.t: It has fragrance but no taste. This is a person who has many good deeds, but less Torah.

SPECIES.name: Willow
SPECIES.y: The willow has neither taste nor fragrance. But without it the mitzvah cannot be done!
SPECIES.t: Neither taste nor fragrance. And yet without the aravah the mitzvah is not fulfilled: without it the whole bundle is invalid.

DEF_HINT: There is no single right answer here. Choose what feels closest to you and see what happens.
